'''Lucien Bender''' was a scientist and a criminal who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You ran experiments on your sons?<br />No! Maybe. I needed test subjects. My work was important. And who are you to judge me! You're as bad as that Meatlump King who stole my boys away from me!! I may not be able to get to him, but I can teach you to keep my boys from me!|A spacer and Lucien Bender|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
Lucien Bender was the father of [[Hraykken Bender|Hraykken]], [[Draykken Bender|Draykken]], and [[Louis Bender]]. His torso and arms were [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]]. A mad scientist, Lucien used to conduct experiments on his own sons. However, prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the three young boys managed to escape their father with the help of a [[Meatlump King|man]] who would later become the [[Meatlump King]]. The man and the three Bender brothers founded the [[Meatlumps]], a gang of technology-hating thugs. In response, Lucien Bender created the [[Bofa Treat Gang]].<ref name="SWG:B" />

[[File:Bofa_Treat_Gang_bunker.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Bofa Treat Gang bunker.]]
After the Battle of Yavin, Lucien Bender was still angered against his traitorous sons and placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the three brothers. However, he ignored that a much larger bounty was placed on him and his gang.<ref name="SWG:B" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] localized Lucien in a [[Bofa Treat Gang bunker|bunker]] near the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]]. The bounty hunter then captured Louis Bender. He intended to force his brothers Hraykken and Draykken to handle Lucien for him so he could collect the most substantial bounty. Bossk was keeping Louis in custody near Lucien's bunker when a spacer affiliated with the Meatlumps arrived to rescue Louis Bender. The bounty hunter revealed that it was not interested by the bounty on Louis' head and agreed with freeing the man upon Lucien would be killed. The spacer therefore attacked the Bofa Treat Gang and finally found Lucien in the depths of the bunker. The adventurer confronted the man and finally killed Lucien Bender.<ref name="SWG:B" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lucien Bender was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:B" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Lucien Bender was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>

[[File:BrotherLucien.png|thumb|right|150px|Cut depiction of brother Lucien.]]
In the ''[[CorSec Database H-Z]]'', published on [[June 16]], [[2006]], the three Bender brothers &mdash; Hraykken, Draykken and Louis &mdash; were originally described as the sons of the Meatlump King.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref> However, when Lucien was added to the game, it was revealed that he was the father of the three boys who were at some point adopted by the Meatlump King.<ref name="SWG:B" />

Analysis of unused game files added with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]" indicated that the three Bender brothers were intended to be named Lempi, Lucien and Hamm, while the father should have been named Andrade.<ref>{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash;  tyrena_meatlump_brothers.stf</ref> The game's files also contain an unused graphical model of a young Lucien. These files indicate that Lucien was originally slated to be the name of one of the brothers leading the gang. The brother Lucien eventually became Louis Bender.<ref>{{GalaxiesNGE}} &mdash; meatlump_brother_lucien.iff</ref>
